A '''battle''' occurred in the [[Lianna system/Legends|Lianna system]] between the [[Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders/Legends|Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]<ref name="Atlas" /> sometime between [[3973 BBY]] and [[3965 BBY]], during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the conflict known as the [[Mandalorian Wars]].<ref name="Date" /> The system was later [[Second battle of the Lianna system|liberated]] by the Republic.<ref name="Atlas" />

==Behind the scenes==
The battle is only referenced once in [[2009]]'s ''[[The Essential Atlas]]''. It is marked on a [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] map showing the battles of the Mandalorian Wars rather than described in prose.
